title: Associator and unit constraints of the normalized ordinary section comparisons
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Λ and a scheme T, put E=(equivalence Λ T).functor, d(M,N)=(ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T M N).hom and e=(ordinaryUnitComparison Λ T).hom. The three ordinary coherence diagrams hold: d(M⊗N,P)≫(d(M,N)▷E(P))≫α = E(α)≫d(M,N⊗P)≫(E(M)◁d(N,P)); d(1,M)≫(e▷E(M))≫λ = E(λ); and d(M,1)≫(E(M)◁e)≫ρ = E(ρ), for all internal modules M,N,P, with the native module tensors and unitors. The maps are the specified normalized comparisons. No derived-category, flatness or nonzero-ring hypothesis is added.

proof.text: Apply the public internal_section_tensor_comparison theorem for the fixed site and coefficient ring. Its scalar-fixing normalization uniquely identifies its unit isomorphism with ordinaryUnitComparison. Its pure-tensor normalization uniquely identifies its tensor isomorphisms with ordinaryTensorComparison. Substitute the resulting unit equality and pointwise tensor equalities into its associator, left unitor and right unitor identities using a general change-of-comparisons lemma. No new structure data are chosen; the existing normalization determines every comparison used.

lean.statement:
theorem section_ordinary_monoidal_constraints (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (∀ M N P : internalModules Λ T,
      (ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T (M ⊗ N) P).hom ≫
          (ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T M N).hom ▷ (equivalence Λ T).functor.obj P ≫
          (α_ _ _ _).hom =
        (equivalence Λ T).functor.map (α_ M N P).hom ≫
          (ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T M (N ⊗ P)).hom ≫
          (equivalence Λ T).functor.obj M ◁ (ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T N P).hom) ∧
    (∀ M : internalModules Λ T,
      (ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T (𝟙_ (internalModules Λ T)) M).hom ≫
          (ordinaryUnitComparison Λ T).hom ▷ (equivalence Λ T).functor.obj M ≫
          (λ_ _).hom = (equivalence Λ T).functor.map (λ_ M).hom) ∧
    (∀ M : internalModules Λ T,
      (ordinaryTensorComparison Λ T M (𝟙_ (internalModules Λ T))).hom ≫
          (equivalence Λ T).functor.obj M ◁ (ordinaryUnitComparison Λ T).hom ≫
          (ρ_ _).hom = (equivalence Λ T).functor.map (ρ_ M).hom)
